title: Using a separating funnel
caption: Two immiscible liquids form layers, the denser one below. Dichloromethane (1.33 g cm⁻³) sinks below water, so an organic product dissolved in it is run off from the bottom through the tap.
alt: A separating funnel with a stopper and tap: an aqueous layer on top and a dichloromethane layer below.
description: Lower layer: dichloromethane (1.33 g cm⁻³), containing the organic product.
Open the stopper, then run off the lower layer through the tap.
